additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386886-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000689] AC socket not working CRM:00642001698
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I went onsite today to test the AC Socket on this charger, and it was not working (charge at 11:45 AM)
Indeed, as you can see in the photos, there is no power delivered by the charger once we connect the cable to the vehicle and the charger. There is still the flag error “QA8 not closing” in the logs but we have already changed QA8 by a new one recently. So, I don’t understand what the problem is.
Can you have a look please ?
